# Kodecz

> Kodecz is an open-source (Apache-2.0) video rendering engine that turns a web page into an MP4. The video is written in HTML, CSS and JavaScript; Kodecz renders it frame by frame on an NVIDIA GPU (NVENC) or on any CPU (x264), without taking a screenshot of every frame. It is an alternative to Remotion and HyperFrames, made to be driven by AI agents. Created by Pedro Henrique Lahr and Vanessa Cristine at Konecz.

Key facts:

- A video is a folder with an `index.html` and a JSON block, `<script type="application/json" id="kodecz">`, that declares `id`, `width`, `height`, `fps` (frames per second) and `frames` (frame count).
- Commands: `kodecz render <folder> <id> out.mp4` (GPU when there is one, CPU when not; `--cpu`, `--gpu`, `--hevc`, `--alpha`, `--from N`, `--frames N`), `kodecz preview <folder> <id> --frame N` (one frame as PNG) and `kodecz check <folder> <id>` (automatic checks, JSON). Install from a clone with `./instalar.sh`, then `npm link` (or run `node cli/kodecz.ts`). Linux only; not on npm yet.
- The original Portuguese names (`id="motor-video"`, `largura`, `altura`, `qps`, `quadros`, `window.motor_quadro`, `--placa`, `--alfa`, `--de`, `--quadros`) are still accepted.
- Animation comes from CSS `@keyframes`, the Web Animations API, GSAP or Lottie; Kodecz puts every animation at frame N before drawing it. Canvas and WebGL go in `window.kodecz_frame(n, ms)`. Timers, `requestAnimationFrame` and the wall clock are not allowed.
- Frame N is deterministic in content and timing, in order, out of order or starting from the middle; Chromium can rasterize animated text up to 2 color levels differently between runs.
- On the same 1080p, 150-frame video, measured the same day (2026-11-02, RTX 5090): Kodecz used 2.0 s of CPU against 37.7 s for Remotion and 22.0 s for HyperFrames, and finished in 2.7 s against 9.9 s and 6.4 s. On the CPU only, HyperFrames is slightly ahead on that video (26.3 s against 28.1 s of CPU).
- Output: MP4 with H.264 or HEVC (GPU only), a transparent layer as raw HEVC with alpha (`--alpha`, GPU only), AAC audio mixed from the page.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): what Kodecz is, quick start, writing a video, how it works, numbers and FAQ
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): how an AI agent writes, previews, checks and renders a Kodecz video
- [Skill: kodecz](skills/kodecz/SKILL.md): make a video with Kodecz (Agent Skills format; `npx skills add konecz/kodecz`, or the Claude Code plugin `/plugin install kodecz --marketplace konecz/kodecz`)
- [Skill: remotion-to-kodecz](skills/remotion-to-kodecz/SKILL.md): port a Remotion project, every API mapped (useCurrentFrame, interpolate, spring, Sequence, Composition, OffthreadVideo)
- [Skill: hyperframes-to-kodecz](skills/hyperframes-to-kodecz/SKILL.md): port a HyperFrames project (data-start, data-duration, clips, window.__timelines)
- [MCP server](mcp/README.md): `render`, `preview` and `check` as MCP tools (npm `kodecz-mcp`, registry name `io.github.konecz/kodecz`)
- [Timeline format](docs/formatos/linha-do-tempo.md): the `index.html` block, animation rules, video and audio
- [Blocks index](blocos/INDICE.md): editing techniques as Kodecz blocks (Portuguese)
- [Measurements](docs/medidas.md): method and raw numbers behind every published figure
- [Patents](docs/patentes.md): H.264 and HEVC, and why Kodecz ships no codec
